Murchison Falls: The Complete Safari Guide

December 5, 2024 7 min read Conservation Trips Team

Uganda's largest national park contains the world's most powerful waterfall and some of East Africa's most exciting game viewing. Here is everything you need to know to plan your Murchison Falls safari.

Planning the perfect Uganda safari requires insider knowledge. As East Africa's premier safari operator since 2008, Conservation Trips and Adventures has guided thousands of travellers through Uganda's extraordinary national parks and wilderness areas.

Uganda — the Pearl of Africa — is home to half the world's remaining mountain gorillas, the chimpanzee capital of the world at Kibale Forest, and over 1,000 bird species. The country offers a diversity of wildlife experiences that few destinations can match.

Getting the Most from Your Safari

Whether you're tracking mountain gorillas in the misty forests of Bwindi, watching tree-climbing lions in Queen Elizabeth National Park, or cruising the Nile at Murchison Falls — timing, preparation, and expert guidance make all the difference.

Our team of certified guides and naturalists are available to answer any questions and craft your personalised itinerary. We respond to all enquiries within 24 hours and require no payment at the enquiry stage.

🌿 Conservation Note

Every safari we organise contributes directly to Uganda's conservation efforts and local community livelihoods. Travel with us is travel that gives back.
